title: Files
subtitle: An inventory of the files in your realm. Drive is where you browse them.

empty.title: No files yet
empty.body: Files you add in Drive, on any of your devices, appear here once this browser has synced them.

read.title: Couldn't read your files
read.body: The file inventory on this browser didn't load. Nothing was changed — try again.

runtime.title: Tenshu isn't running in this tab
runtime.body: The file inventory needs the Tenshu runtime. Reload the page, or close other Tenshu tabs, and try again.

other.title: Something went wrong
other.body: The file inventory couldn't be read. Nothing was changed — try again.

replicaNote: Counted from what this browser has synced: a copy of a file counts separately, and files shared with you aren't included. Your plan's storage use is on
